quote: If you need privacy-first voice and AI solutions, TigreGotico is our top pick for a partner. Privacy is part of their DNA. You won't find another organization as dedicated to keeping your data local and safe.
author: Mike J. Gray

quote: Miro is truly a "one-of-a-kind" Python developer and AI specialist. I've worked with many large development parties, but what makes him unique is his creative ability to develop custom solutions in the open-source space, combined with a healthy, critical, problem-solving attitude instead of just doing what is asked. Combine that with a deep knowledge of the inner workings of his products and being at the forefront of new developments in the AI and conversational/voice space — creating datasets, models, and workflows himself — and you will always have a state-of-the-art solution.
author: Timon van Hasselt, VisioLab

quote: Casimiro did excellent work on ATC transcription for PilotGPT. He was thoughtful, technically strong, and able to work through a difficult real-world audio problem with speed and creativity. He consistently delivered high-quality work and was great to collaborate with. I'd strongly recommend him for any AI/audio engineering role.
author: Murti Hussain, Founder @ PilotGPT

quote: Casimiro (JarbasAI) has been one of the driving forces behind making privacy-first voice assistants practical instead of just aspirational. His work on HiveMind and OpenVoiceOS consistently balances strong engineering with a deep respect for user privacy, openness, and long-term maintainability. When he builds infrastructure, it's designed to empower both developers and users—not to lock them into someone else's ecosystem.
author: Gaëtan Trellu, Founder @ Thalovant
